title: Few & Little
objectives: Use few & little accurately in A2 contexts.
Understand form, meaning, and typical usage.
Produce short spoken and written examples.
canDo: I can use few/little/a few/a little correctly.

warmUp.title: Activate prior knowledge
warmUp.prompt: Before this lesson, recall what you know about few & little. How is it similar or different from Portuguese?
reflectionQuestions: When do native speakers use few & little?
Can you think of one example?

explanation:
Few/a few + plural | Little/a little + uncountable

Few/little = not enough (negative feel) | A few/a little = some (positive)

grammar.title: Few & Little
grammar.rule: Few/a few + plural | Little/a little + uncountable

reading.title: Few & Little in Context
reading.text: Few customers visited the shop yesterday. We have a little milk — enough for coffee. She speaks a few words of Japanese. There is little hope without a plan.

questions.question: What is the main topic of the text?
questions.explanation: The text illustrates this lesson topic.

questions.question: Is this text appropriate for A2 learners?
Which sentence best matches the lesson?

writing.prompt: Write a short paragraph (5–7 sentences) using few & little. Use at least 3 words from the vocabulary list.
rubricHints: Use the target structure at least twice.
writing.modelAnswer: Few people came. Little progress was made. I have a few questions. A little help please.

tutorHints: Correct gently and ask the learner to reformulate.
Use English for meta-language when possible at A2.
